attributes.board_name: Connecticut Department of Public Health (Dental Hygienist licensing)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses offered or approved by CODA-accredited or regionally accredited schools, ADA and affiliated societies, National Dental Association, ADHA and affiliates, Academy of General Dentistry, Academy of Dental Hygiene, Red Cross/AHA (CPR, cardiac life support), VA/armed forces, hospitals, CODA-recognized agencies, medical associations, health departments
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE attestation at the first license renewal.
rules.alternatives: 8 hours of volunteer dental practice at a public health facility = 1 hour, max 5 hours per two years. Waiver/extension for medical disability; exemption if not in active practice (notarized application).
rules.audit_note: Keep attendance records/certificates at least 3 years; submit within 45 days if DPH asks.

topics.who: Infection control in a dental setting

rules.notes: 16 h within the 24 months before renewal (license renews yearly). Max 4 h online/distance learning. Business meetings, banquet speeches and reading books/journals do not count.
